title: What did the 2023 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine recognize?

sources.title: 2023 Nobel Prizes - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: The 2023 Nobel Prizes were awarded by the Nobel Foundation in Sweden. Six categories were awarded: Physics, Chemistry, Physiology or Medicine, Literature, Peace, and Economic Sciences.

sources.title: The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 2023 - NobelPrize.org
sources.snippet: The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 2023 was awarded jointly to Katalin Karikó and Drew Weissman "for their discoveries concerning nucleoside base modifications that enabled the development of effective mRNA vaccines against COVID-19" To cite this section MLA style: The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 2023.

sources.title: Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 2023
sources.snippet: Oct 2, 2023 · In 1951, Max Theiler was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for developing the yellow fever vaccine. Thanks to the progress in molecular biology in recent decades, vaccines based on individual viral components, rather than whole viruses, have been developed.

answer: The 2023 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded to Katalin Karikó and Drew Weissman for their discoveries concerning nucleoside base modifications that enabled the development of effective mRNA vaccines against COVID-19 [6]. Their work used modified RNA for therapeutic treatments, which enabled the development of life-saving COVID-19 RNA vaccines by Pfizer-BioNTech and Moderna [4]. The discoveries concerning nucleoside base modifications allowed the development of effective mRNA vaccines against COVID-19 [5].
